title: EEVblog #388 - Fake Apple USB Charger Teardown
summary: Dave Jones of EEVblog tears down a fake Apple A1265 USB charger and shows the shortcuts that make it unsafe, such as poor isolation.
why: HN points to it as an engineer's evidence of why cheap counterfeit chargers are dangerous.

quote.text: Instead I'll listen to what an electronics engineer thinks about counterfeit chargers
